nodes.name: PyTorch
nodes.description: An open source machine learning framework supported by the Linux Foundation with widespread research adoption.

nodes.name: Transformers (Hugging Face)
nodes.description: State-of-the-art Machine Learning library for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX providing unified model architectures.

nodes.name: vLLM
nodes.description: High-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
nodes.lead_maintainer: vLLM Core Team & UC Berkeley LMSYS

nodes.name: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
nodes.description: Open ecosystem for interchangeable AI models across hardware runtimes and frameworks.

nodes.name: scikit-learn
nodes.description: Predictive data analysis tool built on NumPy, SciPy, and matplotlib, fundamental to classical statistical ML.

nodes.name: llama.cpp
nodes.description: Port of LLM inference in C/C++ without external dependencies, widely adopted for edge and local AI deployment.

nodes.name: Linux Foundation AI & Data
nodes.description: Umbrella foundation supporting open source AI, machine learning, and data innovation.

nodes.name: European Commission
nodes.description: The executive body of the European Union responsible for drafting and enforcing the EU AI Act.

nodes.name: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21
nodes.description: Joint Technical Committee 21 on Artificial Intelligence tasked with drafting harmonised European standards supporting the EU AI Act.

nodes.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42
nodes.description: International standards committee establishing global foundational standards on Artificial Intelligence (ISO/IEC 42001, 22989, 5338).

nodes.name: NIST AI Safety Consortium (AISIC)
nodes.description: Consortium supporting the US AI Safety Institute to develop science-based standards, guidelines, and red-teaming benchmarks.

nodes.name: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE-SA)
nodes.description: Global standardisation body leading ethical and technical AI specifications including IEEE 7000 series and P2801.

nodes.name: EU AI Act (Regulation EU 2024/1689)
nodes.description: Comprehensive regulatory framework establishing risk-based obligations and harmonised standardisation mandates for AI systems.

nodes.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS)
nodes.description: International standard specifying requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system.

edges.notes: Repository link does not establish formal participation or liaison status in CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 committees.
edges.gap_recommendation: Direct researcher toward official CEN-CENELEC national delegation registers (e.g., DIN, AFNOR, BSI), JTC 21 meeting attendance lists, or formal liaison applications rather than general code repositories.

edges.source_passage: Member organizations contributing open-source serving architectures, high-performance runtime verification tools, and benchmark infrastructures include the vLLM project community under open consortium charter.
edges.notes: Confirmed in official NIST consortium roster under academic and open-source infrastructure participants working group.
edges.gap_recommendation: Maintain quarterly monitoring of working group attendance minutes and public contribution logs.

edges.source_passage: The LF AI & Data Foundation submits this comprehensive feedback highlighting the necessity of distinguishing downstream model deployers from foundational open-source library authors within harmonised compliance standards.
edges.notes: Primary consultation document filed through the official European Commission 'Have Your Say' portal with public registration identifier.
edges.gap_recommendation: Track follow-up participation in the AI Office GPAI Code of Practice drafting plenaries.

edges.source_passage: Annex D on model cards and data artifact taxonomy incorporates conventions pioneered in the open-source Hugging Face Transformers model card ecosystem.
edges.notes: Direct textual alignment and technical citation identified in published draft standards documentation, though individual corporate delegates represent the liaison rather than an automated project entity.
edges.gap_recommendation: Verify specific ISO technical committee liaison credentials for contributing project maintainers.

edges.source_passage: IEEE P2801 Recommended Practice for the Quality Management of Datasets for Deep Learning references ONNX model representation exchange formats for reproducible model verification.
edges.notes: Working group liaison documents establish ONNX specification format as benchmark exchange layer in section 4.2.
edges.gap_recommendation: Cross-check formal IEEE liaison ballot records to determine if formal institutional voting rights exist.

edges.source_passage: As European regulatory requirements under the EU AI Act begin implementation, PyTorch Foundation members are coordinating open working sessions regarding telemetry transparency and safety reporting.
edges.notes: Self-reported governance update discussing regulatory environment. Contextually relevant but not equivalent to technical standardisation committee participation.
edges.gap_recommendation: Distinguish between governance awareness discussions and actual participation in harmonised standard drafting mandates.

edges.source_passage: The Inria Scikit-learn Consortium affirms commitment to align validation protocols with emerging CEN-CENELEC trustworthy AI evaluation rubrics.
edges.notes: Consortium press release declares public alignment intent. Does not verify committee membership or accredited submission.
edges.gap_recommendation: Investigate whether AFNOR (French standardisation delegate to CEN) has registered scikit-learn core maintainers as committee experts.

edges.source_passage: Community discussion thread raising questions on whether quantized model distributions will fall under European AI conformity assessments.
edges.notes: Discussion thread represents informal developer conjecture. No evidence of institutional dialogue with standards bodies.
edges.gap_recommendation: Classify as speculative/unresolved until primary documentation of institutional submission emerges.
